bool contains(int mask, int activity)
    return (mask / (2 ^ activity)) % 2 == 1

int[] members(int mask, int size)
    return [for i := (0:<int(size))[] if contains(mask, i) then i]

bool extend_pair(int[] pair, int activity, int side, string[][] relations, int size)
    group := pair[side]
    opposite := pair[1 - side]
    if contains(group, activity) or relations[activity][activity] != "#"
        return false
    for other := members(group, size)[]
        if relations[activity][other] != "#"
            return false
    for other := members(opposite, size)[]
        if (side == 0 and relations[activity][other] != "->") or (side == 1 and relations[other][activity] != "->")
            return false
    return true

bool sequence_before(int[] first, int[] second)
    size := if #first < #second then int(#first) else int(#second)
    for: i < size
        if first[i] != second[i]
            return first[i] < second[i]
    return #first < #second

bool pair_before(int[] first, int[] second, int size)
    a := members(first[0], size)
    b := members(second[0], size)
    return if a != b then sequence_before(a, b) else sequence_before(members(first[1], size), members(second[1], size))

int[][] triangle_counts(int[][] traces, int[] weights, int size)
    counts := [for a := (0:<int(size))[] then [for b := (0:<int(size))[] then 0]]
    for: index < int(#traces)
        trace := traces[index]
        for: 2 <= i < int(#trace)
            if trace[i - 2] == trace[i] and trace[i - 2] != trace[i - 1]
                counts[trace[i - 2]][trace[i - 1]] += weights[index]
    return counts

string plus_relation(int[][] counts, int[][] triangles, int first, int second)
    forward := counts[first][second] > 0
    backward := counts[second][first] > 0
    loop := first != second and triangles[first][second] > 0 and triangles[second][first] > 0
    return if forward and (not backward or loop) then "->" elif backward and (not forward or loop) then "<-" elif forward and backward then "||" else "#"

int name_index(string[] names, string wanted)
    for: i < int(#names)
        if names[i] == wanted
            return i
    return -1

class Net(string[] places, string[] transitions, int[][] inputs, int[][] outputs, int initial, int final)
    int[][] routes := [for p := (0:<int(#places))[] then []]
    for: t < int(#transitions)
        for p := inputs[t][]
            routes[p] = routes[p].append(t)
    int[] initial_marking := [for p := (0:<int(#places))[] then (if p == initial then 1 else 0)]
    int[] final_marking := [for p := (0:<int(#places))[] then (if p == final then 1 else 0)]
    arc_count := 0
    for: t < int(#transitions)
        arc_count += int(#inputs[t]) + int(#outputs[t])

    bool enabled(int[] marking, int transition)
        for p := inputs[transition][]
            if marking[p] == 0
                return false
        return true

    int[] enabled_transitions(int[] marking)
        return [for t := (0:<int(#transitions))[] if enabled(marking, t) then t]

    int[] fire(int[] marking, int transition)
        result := marking
        for p := inputs[transition][]
            result[p] -= 1
        for p := outputs[transition][]
            result[p] += 1
        return result

Net read_model()
    text := string.from_utf8(file.read_bin("input/model.txt"))
    lines := text.split(NL)
    string[] places := []
    string[] transitions := []
    string[][] arcs := []
    initial := ""
    final := ""
    for line := lines[0:<int(#lines) - 1][]
        fields := line.split(" ")
        if fields[0] == "PLACE"
            places = places.append(fields[1])
        elif fields[0] == "TRANSITION"
            transitions = transitions.append(fields[1])
        elif fields[0] == "ARC"
            arcs = arcs.append(fields[1:<3])
        elif fields[0] == "INITIAL"
            initial = fields[1]
        else
            final = fields[1]
    transitions = transitions.sorted()
    int[][] inputs := [for transition := transitions[] then []]
    outputs := inputs
    for arc := arcs[]
        p := name_index(places, arc[0])
        if p >= 0
            t := name_index(transitions, arc[1])
            inputs[t] = inputs[t].append(p)
        else
            t := name_index(transitions, arc[0])
            outputs[t] = outputs[t].append(name_index(places, arc[1]))
    return Net(places, transitions, [for values := inputs[] then values.sorted()], [for values := outputs[] then values.sorted()], name_index(places, initial), name_index(places, final))

int[] fitness(int missing, int remaining, int consumed, int produced)
    return [(consumed - missing) * produced + (produced - remaining) * consumed, 2 * consumed * produced]

class Replay(int place_count, int transition_count)
    missing := 0
    remaining := 0
    consumed := 0
    produced := 0
    skipped := 0
    int[] place_missing := [for p := (0:<int(place_count))[] then 0]
    place_remaining := place_missing
    deviating := place_missing
    int[][] waiting := [for p := (0:<int(place_count))[] then []]
    int[][] routes := [for p := (0:<int(place_count))[] then [for t := (0:<int(transition_count))[] then 0]]

int[][] directly_follows(int[][] traces, int[] weights, int size)
    counts := [for a := (0:<int(size))[] then [for b := (0:<int(size))[] then 0]]
    for: index < int(#traces)
        trace := traces[index]
        for: 1 <= i < int(#trace)
            counts[trace[i - 1]][trace[i]] += weights[index]
    return counts

string basic_relation(int[][] counts, int first, int second)
    forward := counts[first][second] > 0
    backward := counts[second][first] > 0
    return if forward and not backward then "->" elif backward and not forward then "<-" elif forward then "||" else "#"

string align(string value, int width)
    return " " * nat(width - int(#value)) + value

string[] table(string[][] rows, int width)
    size := int(#rows)
    header := "    " + [for i := (1:<(int(size) + 1))[] then align(string(i), width)].join("")
    lines := [header]
    for: i < size
        lines = lines.append(align(string(i + 1), 4) + [for value := rows[i][] then align(value, width)].join(""))
    return lines

string[] footprint(string[] activities, string[][] relations)
    lines := [for i := (0:<int(#activities))[] then "ACTIVITY {i + 1} {activities[i]}"]
    return lines.concat(table(relations, 4))

int parse_integer(string text)
    value := int(text)
    return value

string[] read_lines(string path)
    text := string.from_utf8(file.read_bin(path))
    lines := text.split(NL)
    return lines[0:<int(#lines) - 1]

string[][] read_log()
    lines := read_lines("input/eventlog.csv")
    return [for line := lines[1:<int(#lines)][] then line.split(",")]

string[][] read_parameters()
    return [for line := read_lines("input/params.txt")[] then line.split(" ")]

int timestamp_minutes(string timestamp)
    month := parse_integer(timestamp[5:<7])
    day := parse_integer(timestamp[8:<10])
    hour := parse_integer(timestamp[11:<13])
    minute := parse_integer(timestamp[14:<16])
    months := [31, 28, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31]
    if month < 1 or month > 12 or day < 1 or day > months[month - 1] or hour > 23 or minute > 59
        return -1
    days := day - 1
    for: i < month - 1
        days += months[i]
    return (days * 24 + hour) * 60 + minute

class Event(int line, string case_id, string activity, string timestamp, string resource, int time_value)
class Case(string identifier, Event[] events)

Case[] group_cases(Event[] events)
    names := [for event := events[] then event.case_id].sorted()
    string[] identifiers := []
    for name := names[]
        if #identifiers == 0 or identifiers[-1] != name
            identifiers = identifiers.append(name)
    Case[] cases := []
    for identifier := identifiers[]
        Event[] ordered := []
        for event := events[]
            if event.case_id != identifier
                continue
            position := int(#ordered)
            for: i < int(#ordered)
                if event.time_value < ordered[i].time_value or (event.time_value == ordered[i].time_value and event.line < ordered[i].line)
                    position = i
                    break
            ordered = ordered[0:<position].concat([event]).concat(ordered[position:<int(#ordered)])
        cases = cases.append(Case(identifier, ordered))
    return cases

int[] median(int[] values)
    ordered := values.sorted()
    size := int(#ordered)
    return if size % 2 == 1 then [ordered[size / 2], 1] else [ordered[size / 2 - 1] + ordered[size / 2], 2]

int[] dependency(int[][] counts, int first, int second)
    forward := counts[first][second]
    backward := counts[second][first]
    return [forward - backward, forward + backward + 1]

int[] loop_measure(int count)
    return [count, count + 1]

int[] split_measure(int[][] counts, int activity, int first, int second)
    return [counts[first][second] + counts[second][first], counts[activity][first] + counts[activity][second] + 1]

int[] join_measure(int[][] counts, int activity, int first, int second)
    return [counts[first][second] + counts[second][first], counts[first][activity] + counts[second][activity] + 1]

import eventlog = "./eventlog.qui"
import dfg = "./dfg.qui"
import alpha_miner = "./alpha_miner.qui"
import heuristic_miner = "./heuristic_miner.qui"
import conformance = "./conformance.qui"
import report = "./report.qui"

int sum_values(int[] values)
    result := 0
    for value := values[]
        result += value
    return result

int index_of(string[] values, string wanted)
    for: i < int(#values)
        if values[i] == wanted
            return i
    return -1

int integer_index(int[] values, int wanted)
    for: i < int(#values)
        if values[i] == wanted
            return i
    return -1

string[] unique_strings(string[] values)
    string[] result := []
    for value := values.sorted()[]
        if #result == 0 or result[-1] != value
            result = result.append(value)
    return result

string integer_key(int[] values)
    return [for value := values[] then string(value)].join(",")

int lookup_id(map<string, int> values, string key)
    match values.get(key)
        int found
            return found
        none
            return -1

int[] parse_fraction(string value)
    parts := value.split("/")
    return [eventlog.parse_integer(parts[0]), eventlog.parse_integer(parts[1])]

string fraction_value(int numerator, int denominator)
    return report.fraction([numerator, denominator])

string yes_no(bool value)
    return if value then "yes" else "no"

class Params(int filter_min, int sla, int observations, int[] dependency_threshold, int[] relative_best, int[] loop1_threshold, int[] loop2_threshold, int[] and_threshold)

Params extract_parameters()
    rows := eventlog.read_parameters()
    return Params(eventlog.parse_integer(rows[0][1]), eventlog.parse_integer(rows[1][1]), eventlog.parse_integer(rows[2][1]), parse_fraction(rows[3][1]), parse_fraction(rows[4][1]), parse_fraction(rows[5][1]), parse_fraction(rows[6][1]), parse_fraction(rows[7][1]))

class Validated(eventlog.Event[] events, string[] errors)

Validated validate_rows(string[][] rows)
    eventlog.Event[] events := []
    string[] errors := []
    distinct<string> adopted
    for: i < int(#rows)
        row := rows[i]
        minute := eventlog.timestamp_minutes(row[2])
        if minute < 0
            errors = errors.append("line {i + 2}: bad timestamp {row[2]}")
            continue
        string identity := row[0] + HT + row[1] + HT + row[2]
        if adopted.has(identity)
            errors = errors.append("line {i + 2}: duplicate event {row[0]} {row[1]} {row[2]}")
            continue
        .adopted.add(identity)
        events = events.append(eventlog.Event(i + 2, row[0], row[1], row[2], row[3], minute))
    return Validated(events, errors)

class Case(string identifier, eventlog.Event[] events, int[] trace, int[] resources)
    int duration := events[-1].time_value - events[0].time_value
    variant := 0

class Variant(int[] trace, int[] cases, bool keep)

bool variant_before(Variant first, Variant second)
    return if #first.cases != #second.cases then #first.cases > #second.cases else alpha_miner.sequence_before(first.trace, second.trace)

Variant[] make_variants(Case[] cases, int[][] counts, int minimum)
    Variant[] grouped := []
    for: i < int(#cases)
        group := -1
        for: j < int(#grouped)
            if grouped[j].trace == cases[i].trace
                group = j
                break
        if group < 0
            keep := true
            trace := cases[i].trace
            for: 1 <= j < int(#trace)
                if counts[trace[j - 1]][trace[j]] < minimum
                    keep = false
            grouped = grouped.append(Variant(trace, [i], keep))
        else
            grouped[group].cases = grouped[group].cases.append(i)
    Variant[] result := []
    for item := grouped[]
        position := int(#result)
        for: i < int(#result)
            if variant_before(item, result[i])
                position = i
                break
        result = result[0:<position].concat([item]).concat(result[position:<int(#result)])
    return result

int[] log_activities(int[][] traces, int size)
    present := [for i := (0:<int(size))[] then false]
    for trace := traces[]
        for activity := trace[]
            present[activity] = true
    return [for i := (0:<int(size))[] if present[i] then i]

string[] footprint_lines(string[] names, int[] activities, string[][] relations)
    selected_names := [for i := activities[] then names[i]]
    cells := [for a := activities[] then [for b := activities[] then relations[a][b]]]
    return dfg.footprint(selected_names, cells)

class Discovery(conformance.Net net, int candidate_count, int causal_count, int[][] pairs, int[] activities, string[][] relations)

Discovery discover_net(int[][] traces, int[] activities, string[] names, string[][] relations)
    size := int(#names)
    int[][] candidates := []
    distinct<string> seen
    causal := 0
    for a := activities[]
        for b := activities[]
            if relations[a][b] != "->"
                continue
            causal += 1
            if relations[a][a] == "#" and relations[b][b] == "#"
                pair := [2 ^ a, 2 ^ b]
                key := integer_key(pair)
                if not seen.has(key)
                    .seen.add(key)
                    candidates = candidates.append(pair)
    cursor := 0
    while cursor < int(#candidates)
        pair := candidates[cursor]
        cursor += 1
        for activity := activities[]
            for: side < 2
                if alpha_miner.extend_pair(pair, activity, side, relations, size)
                    grown := pair
                    grown[side] += 2 ^ activity
                    key := integer_key(grown)
                    if not seen.has(key)
                        .seen.add(key)
                        candidates = candidates.append(grown)
    int[][] maximal := []
    for pair := candidates[]
        extendable := false
        for activity := activities[]
            for: side < 2
                extendable = extendable or alpha_miner.extend_pair(pair, activity, side, relations, size)
        if extendable
            continue
        position := int(#maximal)
        for: i < int(#maximal)
            if alpha_miner.pair_before(pair, maximal[i], size)
                position = i
                break
        maximal = maximal[0:<position].concat([pair]).concat(maximal[position:<int(#maximal)])
    string[] places := ["start"].concat([for i := (0:<int(#maximal))[] then "p{i + 1}"]).concat(["end"])
    transitions := [for activity := activities[] then names[activity]]
    int[][] inputs := [for t := (0:<int(#transitions))[] then []]
    outputs := inputs
    final := int(#places) - 1
    starts := [for i := (0:<int(size))[] then false]
    ends := starts
    for trace := traces[]
        starts[trace[0]] = true
        ends[trace[-1]] = true
    for: t < int(#activities)
        activity := activities[t]
        if starts[activity]
            inputs[t] = inputs[t].append(0)
        for: i < int(#maximal)
            if alpha_miner.contains(maximal[i][1], activity)
                inputs[t] = inputs[t].append(i + 1)
            if alpha_miner.contains(maximal[i][0], activity)
                outputs[t] = outputs[t].append(i + 1)
        if ends[activity]
            outputs[t] = outputs[t].append(final)
    return Discovery(conformance.Net(places, transitions, inputs, outputs, 0, final), int(#candidates), causal, maximal, activities, relations)

class PlusResult(Discovery discovery, int[] loop_places, int[][] triangles)

PlusResult discover_plus(int[][] traces, int[] weights, int[] activities, int[] loops, string[] names, int[][] counts)
    size := int(#names)
    reduced_activities := [for activity := activities[] if integer_index(loops, activity) < 0 then activity]
    reduced := [for trace := traces[] then [for activity := trace[] if integer_index(loops, activity) < 0 then activity]]
    reduced_counts := dfg.directly_follows(reduced, weights, size)
    triangles := alpha_miner.triangle_counts(reduced, weights, size)
    relations := [for a := (0:<int(size))[] then [for b := (0:<int(size))[] then alpha_miner.plus_relation(reduced_counts, triangles, a, b)]]
    discovered := discover_net(reduced, reduced_activities, names, relations)
    int[][] inputs := [for activity := activities[] then []]
    outputs := inputs
    for: i < int(#reduced_activities)
        t := integer_index(activities, reduced_activities[i])
        inputs[t] = discovered.net.inputs[i]
        outputs[t] = discovered.net.outputs[i]
    loop_places := [for i := (0:<int(size))[] then -1]
    for loop_activity := loops[]
        predecessors := 0
        successors := 0
        for activity := reduced_activities[]
            if counts[activity][loop_activity] > 0
                predecessors += 2 ^ activity
            if counts[loop_activity][activity] > 0
                successors += 2 ^ activity
        for: p < int(#discovered.pairs)
            if discovered.pairs[p] == [predecessors, successors]
                t := integer_index(activities, loop_activity)
                loop_places[loop_activity] = p + 1
                inputs[t] = [p + 1]
                outputs[t] = [p + 1]
                break
    transitions := [for activity := activities[] then names[activity]]
    discovered.net = conformance.Net(discovered.net.places, transitions, inputs, outputs, discovered.net.initial, discovered.net.final)
    return PlusResult(discovered, loop_places, triangles)

class Reachability(int markings, int edges, int unsafe, int deadlocks, int stuck, bool final, int[] dead, bool sound, bool[][] follows)

Reachability explore_net(conformance.Net net)
    transitions := int(#net.transitions)
    markings := [net.initial_marking]
    map<string, int> positions
    .positions.set(integer_key(net.initial_marking), 0)
    int[][] edges := []
    unsafe := 0
    deadlocks := 0
    enabled_ever := [for t := (0:<int(transitions))[] then false]
    follows := [for t := (0:<int(transitions))[] then [for u := (0:<int(transitions))[] then false]]
    cursor := 0
    while cursor < int(#markings)
        marking := markings[cursor]
        enabled := net.enabled_transitions(marking)
        if #enabled == 0 and marking != net.final_marking
            deadlocks += 1
        for t := enabled[]
            enabled_ever[t] = true
            following := net.fire(marking, t)
            safe := true
            for tokens := following[]
                safe = safe and tokens <= 1
            if not safe
                unsafe += 1
                continue
            key := integer_key(following)
            target := lookup_id(positions, key)
            if target < 0
                target = int(#markings)
                .positions.set(key, target)
                markings = markings.append(following)
            edges = edges.append([cursor, target, t])
            for u := net.enabled_transitions(following)[]
                follows[t][u] = true
        cursor += 1
    final_index := lookup_id(positions, integer_key(net.final_marking))
    reaches_final := [for i := (0:<int(#markings))[] then i == final_index]
    changed := true
    while changed
        changed = false
        for edge := edges[]
            if reaches_final[edge[1]] and not reaches_final[edge[0]]
                reaches_final[edge[0]] = true
                changed = true
    stuck := int(#[for reaches := reaches_final[] if not reaches then reaches])
    dead := [for t := (0:<int(transitions))[] if not enabled_ever[t] then t]
    return Reachability(int(#markings), int(#edges), unsafe, deadlocks, stuck, final_index >= 0, dead, unsafe == 0 and stuck == 0 and #dead == 0, follows)

conformance.Replay replay_case(Case record, conformance.Net net, string[] activity_names)
    places := int(#net.places)
    result := conformance.Replay(places, int(#net.transitions))
    int[][] tokens := [for p := (0:<int(places))[] then []]
    tokens[net.initial] = [record.events[0].time_value]
    result.produced = 1
    for: i < int(#record.trace)
        t := index_of(net.transitions, activity_names[record.trace[i]])
        if t < 0
            result.skipped += 1
            continue
        minute := record.events[i].time_value
        for p := net.inputs[t][]
            result.consumed += 1
            if #tokens[p] == 0
                result.missing += 1
                result.place_missing[p] += 1
            else
                result.waiting[p] = result.waiting[p].append(minute - tokens[p][0])
                tokens[p] = tokens[p][1:<int(#tokens[p])]
                result.routes[p][t] += 1
        for p := net.outputs[t][]
            tokens[p] = tokens[p].append(minute)
            result.produced += 1
    result.consumed += 1
    final := net.final
    if #tokens[final] == 0
        result.missing += 1
        result.place_missing[final] += 1
    else
        tokens[final] = tokens[final][1:<int(#tokens[final])]
    for: p < places
        remaining := int(#tokens[p])
        result.place_remaining[p] = remaining
        result.remaining += remaining
        result.deviating[p] = if remaining > 0 or result.place_missing[p] > 0 then 1 else 0
    return result

class Replays(conformance.Replay[] cases, conformance.Replay totals, int fitting)

Replays replay_all(Case[] cases, conformance.Net net, string[] names)
    totals := conformance.Replay(int(#net.places), int(#net.transitions))
    conformance.Replay[] records := []
    fitting := 0
    for record := cases[]
        result := replay_case(record, net, names)
        records = records.append(result)
        if result.missing == 0 and result.remaining == 0
            fitting += 1
        totals.missing += result.missing
        totals.remaining += result.remaining
        totals.consumed += result.consumed
        totals.produced += result.produced
        totals.skipped += result.skipped
        for: p < int(#net.places)
            totals.place_missing[p] += result.place_missing[p]
            totals.place_remaining[p] += result.place_remaining[p]
            totals.deviating[p] += result.deviating[p]
            totals.waiting[p] = totals.waiting[p].concat(result.waiting[p])
            for: t < int(#net.transitions)
                totals.routes[p][t] += result.routes[p][t]
    return Replays(records, totals, fitting)

class Prefix(int[] trace, int weight, bool[] followers)

Prefix[] build_prefixes(Case[] cases, int activity_count)
    Prefix[] prefixes := []
    map<string, int> positions
    for record := cases[]
        for: length <= int(#record.trace)
            trace := record.trace[0:<length]
            key := integer_key(trace)
            index := lookup_id(positions, key)
            if index < 0
                index = int(#prefixes)
                .positions.set(key, index)
                prefixes = prefixes.append(Prefix(trace, 0, [for a := (0:<int(activity_count))[] then false]))
            prefixes[index].weight += 1
            if length < int(#record.trace)
                prefixes[index].followers[record.trace[length]] = true
    return prefixes

class Precision(int prefixes, int allowed, int escaping, int[] escape_weights)

Precision prefix_precision(conformance.Net net, Prefix[] prefixes, string[] activities)
    fitting := 0
    allowed := 0
    escaping := 0
    weights := [for name := net.transitions[] then 0]
    for prefix := prefixes[]
        marking := net.initial_marking
        fit := true
        for activity := prefix.trace[]
            t := index_of(net.transitions, activities[activity])
            if t < 0 or not net.enabled(marking, t)
                fit = false
                break
            marking = net.fire(marking, t)
        if not fit
            continue
        fitting += 1
        for t := net.enabled_transitions(marking)[]
            allowed += prefix.weight
            activity := index_of(activities, net.transitions[t])
            if activity < 0 or not prefix.followers[activity]
                escaping += prefix.weight
                weights[t] += prefix.weight
    return Precision(fitting, allowed, escaping, weights)

string[] net_lines(conformance.Net net, int[][] pairs, string[] activities)
    string[] lines := []
    size := int(#activities)
    for: p < int(#net.places)
        string[] before := []
        string[] after := []
        for: t < int(#net.transitions)
            if integer_index(net.outputs[t], p) >= 0
                before = before.append(net.transitions[t])
            if integer_index(net.inputs[t], p) >= 0
                after = after.append(net.transitions[t])
        if p > 0 and p + 1 < int(#net.places)
            before = [for a := alpha_miner.members(pairs[p - 1][0], size)[] then activities[a]]
            after = [for a := alpha_miner.members(pairs[p - 1][1], size)[] then activities[a]]
        lines = lines.append("PLACE {net.places[p]} " + report.names(before) + " " + report.names(after))
    for: t < int(#net.transitions)
        inputs := [for p := net.inputs[t][] then net.places[p]]
        outputs := [for p := net.outputs[t][] then net.places[p]]
        lines = lines.append("TRANSITION {net.transitions[t]} in " + report.names(inputs) + " out " + report.names(outputs))
    return lines.append("NET places {#net.places} transitions {#net.transitions} arcs {net.arc_count}")

string[] heuristic_lines(int[][] counts, int[][] triangles, string[] names, Params params)
    size := int(#names)
    loop1 := [for a := (0:<int(size))[] then false]
    loop2 := [for a := (0:<int(size))[] then [for b := (0:<int(size))[] then false]]
    edges := loop2
    string[] lines := []
    loops1 := 0
    loops2 := 0
    for: a < size
        count := counts[a][a]
        if count == 0
            continue
        measure := heuristic_miner.loop_measure(count)
        accepted := count >= params.observations and report.compare(measure, params.loop1_threshold) >= 0
        loop1[a] = accepted
        edges[a][a] = accepted
        if accepted
            loops1 += 1
        lines = lines.append("L1 {names[a]} count {count} measure " + report.fraction(measure) + " " + (if accepted then "ACCEPT" else "REJECT"))
    for: a < size
        for: a + 1 <= b < size
            count := triangles[a][b] + triangles[b][a]
            if loop1[a] or loop1[b] or count == 0
                continue
            measure := heuristic_miner.loop_measure(count)
            accepted := count >= params.observations and report.compare(measure, params.loop2_threshold) >= 0
            loop2[a][b] = accepted
            loop2[b][a] = accepted
            if accepted
                loops2 += 1
            lines = lines.append("L2 {names[a]} {names[b]} count {count} measure " + report.fraction(measure) + " " + (if accepted then "ACCEPT" else "REJECT"))
    int[][] best_out := [for a := (0:<int(size))[] then [-1, 1]]
    best_in := best_out
    for: a < size
        for: b < size
            if a == b or counts[a][b] == 0
                continue
            measure := heuristic_miner.dependency(counts, a, b)
            if report.compare(measure, best_out[a]) > 0
                best_out[a] = measure
            if report.compare(measure, best_in[b]) > 0
                best_in[b] = measure
    for: a < size
        for: b < size
            if a == b or counts[a][b] == 0
                continue
            measure := heuristic_miner.dependency(counts, a, b)
            verdict := "ACCEPT"
            if loop2[a][b]
                verdict = "LOOP2"
            elif counts[a][b] < params.observations
                verdict = "REJECT_COUNT"
            elif report.compare(measure, params.dependency_threshold) < 0
                verdict = "REJECT_MEASURE"
            elif report.compare(report.difference(best_out[a], measure), params.relative_best) > 0 and report.compare(report.difference(best_in[b], measure), params.relative_best) > 0
                verdict = "REJECT_BEST"
            if verdict == "ACCEPT" or verdict == "LOOP2"
                edges[a][b] = true
            lines = lines.append("DEP {names[a]} {names[b]} count {counts[a][b]} reverse {counts[b][a]} measure " + report.fraction(measure) + " {verdict}")
    for: a < size
        inputs := [for b := (0:<int(size))[] if edges[b][a] then names[b]]
        outputs := [for b := (0:<int(size))[] if edges[a][b] then names[b]]
        lines = lines.append("NODE {names[a]} in " + report.names(inputs) + " out " + report.names(outputs))
    edge_count := 0
    for: a < size
        for: b < size
            if edges[a][b]
                edge_count += 1
        for: side < 2
            neighbours := [for b := (0:<int(size))[] if b != a and (if side == 0 then edges[a][b] else edges[b][a]) then b]
            for: i < int(#neighbours)
                for: i + 1 <= j < int(#neighbours)
                    b := neighbours[i]
                    c := neighbours[j]
                    measure := if side == 0 then heuristic_miner.split_measure(counts, a, b, c) else heuristic_miner.join_measure(counts, a, b, c)
                    kind := if side == 0 then "SPLIT" else "JOIN"
                    verdict := if report.compare(measure, params.and_threshold) >= 0 then "AND" else "XOR"
                    lines = lines.append("{kind} {names[a]} {names[b]} {names[c]} measure " + report.fraction(measure) + " {verdict}")
    return lines.append("GRAPH activities {size} edges {edge_count} loops1 {loops1} loops2 {loops2}")

class Study(string[][] rows, Params params, conformance.Net reference)
    validated := validate_rows(rows)
    eventlog.Event[] events := validated.events
    string[] activities := unique_strings([for event := events[] then event.activity])
    string[] resources := unique_strings([for event := events[] then event.resource])
    activity_count := int(#activities)
    resource_count := int(#resources)
    Case[] cases := [for record := eventlog.group_cases(events)[] then Case(record.identifier, record.events, [for event := record.events[] then index_of(activities, event.activity)], [for event := record.events[] then index_of(resources, event.resource)])]
    case_count := int(#cases)
    int[][] traces := [for record := cases[] then record.trace]
    int[] weights := [for record := cases[] then 1]
    int[][] counts := dfg.directly_follows(traces, weights, activity_count)
    int[][] triangles := alpha_miner.triangle_counts(traces, weights, activity_count)
    Variant[] variants := make_variants(cases, counts, params.filter_min)
    for: i < int(#variants)
        for case_index := variants[i].cases[]
            cases[case_index].variant = i + 1
    int[][] filtered := [for variant := variants[] if variant.keep then variant.trace]
    int[] filtered_weights := [for variant := variants[] if variant.keep then int(#variant.cases)]
    kept_cases := sum_values(filtered_weights)
    int kept_events := sum_values([for i := (0:<int(#filtered))[] then int(#filtered[i]) * filtered_weights[i]])
    int[][] filtered_counts := dfg.directly_follows(filtered, filtered_weights, activity_count)
    filtered_activities := log_activities(filtered, activity_count)
    int[] loops := [for a := filtered_activities[] if filtered_counts[a][a] > 0 then a]
    string[][] full_relations := [for a := (0:<int(activity_count))[] then [for b := (0:<int(activity_count))[] then dfg.basic_relation(counts, a, b)]]
    string[][] filtered_relations := [for a := (0:<int(activity_count))[] then [for b := (0:<int(activity_count))[] then dfg.basic_relation(filtered_counts, a, b)]]
    alpha := discover_net(filtered, filtered_activities, activities, filtered_relations)
    plus := discover_plus(filtered, filtered_weights, filtered_activities, loops, activities, filtered_counts)
    conformance.Net[] nets := [reference, alpha.net, plus.discovery.net]
    net_names := ["reference", "alpha", "alpha_plus"]
    Reachability[] reachability := [for net := nets[] then explore_net(net)]
    prefixes := build_prefixes(cases, activity_count)
    Precision[] precisions := [for net := nets[] then prefix_precision(net, prefixes, activities)]
    Replays[] replays := [for net := nets[] then replay_all(cases, net, activities)]

    string trace_names(int[] trace)
        return report.names([for activity := trace[] then activities[activity]])

    string[] log_summary()
        lines := [for problem := validated.errors[] then "ERROR " + problem]
        first := 0
        last := 0
        for: i < int(#events)
            if events[i].time_value < events[first].time_value
                first = i
            if events[i].time_value > events[last].time_value
                last = i
        lines = lines.append("LOG rows {#rows} adopted {#events} rejected {#validated.errors} cases {case_count} activities {activity_count} resources {resource_count} first {events[first].timestamp} last {events[last].timestamp}")
        event_counts := [for a := (0:<int(activity_count))[] then 0]
        case_counts := event_counts
        starts := event_counts
        ends := event_counts
        rework := event_counts
        int[][] waiting := [for a := (0:<int(activity_count))[] then []]
        used_resources := [for a := (0:<int(activity_count))[] then [for r := (0:<int(resource_count))[] then false]]
        weekday_events := [for d := (0:<7)[] then 0]
        weekday_starts := weekday_events
        weekday_ends := weekday_events
        for record := cases[]
            occurrences := [for a := (0:<int(activity_count))[] then 0]
            starts[record.trace[0]] += 1
            ends[record.trace[-1]] += 1
            weekday_starts[(record.events[0].time_value / 1440 + 3) % 7] += 1
            weekday_ends[(record.events[-1].time_value / 1440 + 3) % 7] += 1
            for: i < int(#record.trace)
                activity := record.trace[i]
                occurrences[activity] += 1
                event_counts[activity] += 1
                used_resources[activity][record.resources[i]] = true
                weekday_events[(record.events[i].time_value / 1440 + 3) % 7] += 1
                if i > 0
                    waiting[activity] = waiting[activity].append(record.events[i].time_value - record.events[i - 1].time_value)
            for: a < activity_count
                if occurrences[a] > 0
                    case_counts[a] += 1
                if occurrences[a] > 1
                    rework[a] += 1
        for: a < activity_count
            wait := if #waiting[a] == 0 then "-" else fraction_value(sum_values(waiting[a]), int(#waiting[a]))
            resource_total := int(#[for used := used_resources[a][] if used then used])
            lines = lines.append("ACTIVITY {activities[a]} events {event_counts[a]} cases {case_counts[a]} start {starts[a]} end {ends[a]} rework {rework[a]} wait {wait} resources {resource_total} model " + yes_no(index_of(reference.transitions, activities[a]) >= 0))
        lengths := [for record := cases[] then int(#record.trace)]
        durations := [for record := cases[] then record.duration]
        lists := [lengths, durations]
        labels := ["LENGTH", "DURATION"]
        for: i < 2
            ordered := lists[i].sorted()
            lines = lines.append("{labels[i]} min {ordered[0]} max {ordered[case_count - 1]} mean " + fraction_value(sum_values(ordered), case_count) + " median " + report.fraction(eventlog.median(ordered)))
        days := [for duration := durations[] then duration / 1440]
        max_day := days.sorted()[case_count - 1]
        for: day <= max_day
            count := int(#[for value := days[] if value == day then value])
            lines = lines.append("DAYS {day} cases {count} share " + report.percentage(count, case_count))
        late := int(#[for duration := durations[] if duration > params.sla then duration])
        lines = lines.append("SLA limit {params.sla} late {late} share " + report.percentage(late, case_count))
        weekdays := ["Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat", "Sun"]
        for: day < 7
            lines = lines.append("WEEKDAY {weekdays[day]} events {weekday_events[day]} starts {weekday_starts[day]} ends {weekday_ends[day]}")
        return lines

    string[] variant_lines()
        string[] lines := []
        for: i < int(#variants)
            variant := variants[i]
            count := int(#variant.cases)
            duration_sum := sum_values([for index := variant.cases[] then cases[index].duration])
            late := int(#[for index := variant.cases[] if cases[index].duration > params.sla then index])
            replay := replays[0].cases[variant.cases[0]]
            fitness := conformance.fitness(replay.missing, replay.remaining, replay.consumed, replay.produced)
            decision := if variant.keep then "KEEP" else "DROP"
            lines = lines.append("VARIANT {i + 1} count {count} share " + report.percentage(count, case_count) + " length {#variant.trace} first {cases[variant.cases[0]].identifier} duration " + fraction_value(duration_sum, count) + " late {late} fitness " + report.fraction(fitness) + " {decision} " + trace_names(variant.trace))
        return lines.append("FILTER min_follows {params.filter_min} variants {#filtered} of {#variants} cases {kept_cases} of {case_count} events {kept_events} of {#events}")

    string[] dfg_lines()
        starts := [for a := (0:<int(activity_count))[] then 0]
        int[][] durations := [for a := (0:<int(activity_count))[] then []]
        int[][][] waiting := [for a := (0:<int(activity_count))[] then [for b := (0:<int(activity_count))[] then []]]
        case_counts := [for a := (0:<int(activity_count))[] then [for b := (0:<int(activity_count))[] then 0]]
        for record := cases[]
            starts[record.trace[0]] += 1
            end := record.trace[-1]
            durations[end] = durations[end].append(record.duration)
            seen := [for a := (0:<int(activity_count))[] then [for b := (0:<int(activity_count))[] then false]]
            for: 1 <= i < int(#record.trace)
                a := record.trace[i - 1]
                b := record.trace[i]
                waiting[a][b] = waiting[a][b].append(record.events[i].time_value - record.events[i - 1].time_value)
                seen[a][b] = true
            for: a < activity_count
                for: b < activity_count
                    if seen[a][b]
                        case_counts[a][b] += 1
        upper := int(#events)
        keys := [for a := (0:<int(activity_count))[] if starts[a] > 0 then (upper - starts[a]) * activity_count + a]
        string[] lines := []
        for key := keys.sorted()[]
            a := key % activity_count
            lines = lines.append("START {activities[a]} count {starts[a]}")
        keys = [for a := (0:<int(activity_count))[] if #durations[a] > 0 then (upper - int(#durations[a])) * activity_count + a]
        for key := keys.sorted()[]
            a := key % activity_count
            lines = lines.append("END {activities[a]} count {#durations[a]} duration " + fraction_value(sum_values(durations[a]), int(#durations[a])))
        base := activity_count * activity_count
        keys = []
        for: a < activity_count
            for: b < activity_count
                if counts[a][b] > 0
                    keys = keys.append((upper - counts[a][b]) * base + a * activity_count + b)
        for key := keys.sorted()[]
            pair := key % base
            a := pair / activity_count
            b := pair % activity_count
            ordered := waiting[a][b].sorted()
            lines = lines.append("EDGE {activities[a]} {activities[b]} count {counts[a][b]} cases {case_counts[a][b]} mean " + fraction_value(sum_values(ordered), int(#ordered)) + " min {ordered[0]} max {ordered[-1]}")
        return lines.concat(footprint_lines(activities, [for a := (0:<int(activity_count))[] then a], full_relations))

    string pair_summary(Discovery discovery)
        return "PAIRS causal {discovery.causal_count} candidates {discovery.candidate_count} maximal {#discovery.pairs}"

    string[] alpha_lines()
        string[] lines := ["LOG variants {#filtered} cases {kept_cases} activities " + trace_names(filtered_activities), "LOOPS " + trace_names(loops), "MINER alpha"]
        lines = lines.concat(footprint_lines(activities, alpha.activities, alpha.relations)).append(pair_summary(alpha)).concat(net_lines(alpha.net, alpha.pairs, activities))
        lines = lines.append("MINER alpha_plus")
        for: a < activity_count
            for: b < activity_count
                if plus.triangles[a][b] > 0
                    lines = lines.append("TRIANGLE {activities[a]} {activities[b]} count {plus.triangles[a][b]}")
        discovery := plus.discovery
        lines = lines.concat(footprint_lines(activities, discovery.activities, discovery.relations)).append(pair_summary(discovery))
        for activity := loops[]
            before := [for other := discovery.activities[] if filtered_counts[other][activity] > 0 then other]
            after := [for other := discovery.activities[] if filtered_counts[activity][other] > 0 then other]
            p := plus.loop_places[activity]
            place := if p < 0 then "-" else discovery.net.places[p]
            lines = lines.append("LOOP {activities[activity]} before " + trace_names(before) + " after " + trace_names(after) + " place {place}")
        return lines.concat(net_lines(discovery.net, discovery.pairs, activities))

    string[] conformance_rows()
        lines := ["case_id,variant,events,skipped,missing,remaining,consumed,produced,fitness"]
        for: i < case_count
            record := cases[i]
            replay := replays[0].cases[i]
            fitness := report.fraction(conformance.fitness(replay.missing, replay.remaining, replay.consumed, replay.produced))
            lines = lines.append("{record.identifier},{record.variant},{#record.trace},{replay.skipped},{replay.missing},{replay.remaining},{replay.consumed},{replay.produced},{fitness}")
        return lines

    string model_relation(int net_index, string first, string second)
        net := nets[net_index]
        a := index_of(net.transitions, first)
        b := index_of(net.transitions, second)
        if a < 0 or b < 0
            return "#"
        forward := reachability[net_index].follows[a][b]
        backward := reachability[net_index].follows[b][a]
        return if forward and not backward then "->" elif backward and not forward then "<-" elif forward then "||" else "#"

    string[] footprint_check_lines(int net_index)
        names := unique_strings(activities.concat(nets[net_index].transitions))
        size := int(#names)
        differing := 0
        string[] differences := []
        for: i < size
            for: j < size
                a := index_of(activities, names[i])
                b := index_of(activities, names[j])
                log_relation := if a < 0 or b < 0 then "#" else full_relations[a][b]
                string net_relation := model_relation(net_index, names[i], names[j])
                if log_relation != net_relation
                    differing += 1
                    if net_index == 0 and i <= j
                        differences = differences.append("DIFF {names[i]} {names[j]} log {log_relation} model {net_relation}")
        line := "FOOTPRINT {net_names[net_index]} activities {size} cells {size * size} differing {differing} fitness " + fraction_value(size * size - differing, size * size)
        return [line].concat(differences)

    string[] conformance_lines()
        lines := ["MODEL places {#reference.places} transitions {#reference.transitions} arcs {reference.arc_count}"]
        for: i < 3
            result := reachability[i]
            dead := [for t := result.dead[] then nets[i].transitions[t]]
            lines = lines.append("REACHABILITY {net_names[i]} markings {result.markings} edges {result.edges} unsafe {result.unsafe} deadlocks {result.deadlocks} stuck {result.stuck} final " + yes_no(result.final) + " dead " + report.names(dead) + " sound " + yes_no(result.sound))
        for: i < 3
            lines = lines.concat(footprint_check_lines(i))
        for: i < 3
            precision := precisions[i]
            value := if precision.allowed == 0 then fraction_value(1, 1) else fraction_value(precision.allowed - precision.escaping, precision.allowed)
            lines = lines.append("PRECISION {net_names[i]} prefixes {precision.prefixes} allowed {precision.allowed} escaping {precision.escaping} precision {value}")
            size := int(#nets[i].transitions)
            maximum_weight := 0
            for weight := precision.escape_weights[]
                if weight > maximum_weight
                    maximum_weight = weight
            keys := [for t := (0:<int(size))[] if precision.escape_weights[t] > 0 then (maximum_weight - precision.escape_weights[t]) * size + t]
            for key := keys.sorted()[]
                t := key % size
                lines = lines.append("ESCAPE {net_names[i]} {nets[i].transitions[t]} weight {precision.escape_weights[t]}")
        for: i < 3
            net := nets[i]
            totals := replays[i].totals
            fitness := report.fraction(conformance.fitness(totals.missing, totals.remaining, totals.consumed, totals.produced))
            lines = lines.append("REPLAY {net_names[i]} cases {case_count} fitting {replays[i].fitting} skipped {totals.skipped} missing {totals.missing} remaining {totals.remaining} consumed {totals.consumed} produced {totals.produced} fitness {fitness}")
            for: p < int(#net.places)
                waiting := totals.waiting[p]
                average := if #waiting == 0 then "-" else fraction_value(sum_values(waiting), int(#waiting))
                maximum_wait := if #waiting == 0 then "-" else string(waiting.sorted()[-1])
                lines = lines.append("PLACE {net_names[i]} {net.places[p]} missing {totals.place_missing[p]} remaining {totals.place_remaining[p]} deviating {totals.deviating[p]} tokens {#waiting} mean {average} max {maximum_wait}")
            for: p < int(#net.places)
                if #net.routes[p] < 2
                    continue
                consumptions := [for t := net.routes[p][] then net.transitions[t] + "={totals.routes[p][t]}"]
                lines = lines.append("ROUTE {net_names[i]} {net.places[p]} " + consumptions.join(","))
        return lines

    string[] resource_lines()
        work := [for r := (0:<int(resource_count))[] then [for a := (0:<int(activity_count))[] then 0]]
        case_counts := [for r := (0:<int(resource_count))[] then 0]
        handovers := [for r := (0:<int(resource_count))[] then [for s := (0:<int(resource_count))[] then 0]]
        handover_cases := handovers
        subcontracts := handovers
        together := handovers
        for record := cases[]
            present := [for r := (0:<int(resource_count))[] then false]
            seen_handover := [for r := (0:<int(resource_count))[] then [for s := (0:<int(resource_count))[] then false]]
            for: i < int(#record.trace)
                r := record.resources[i]
                present[r] = true
                work[r][record.trace[i]] += 1
                if i > 0
                    previous := record.resources[i - 1]
                    handovers[previous][r] += 1
                    seen_handover[previous][r] = true
                if i >= 2 and record.resources[i - 2] == r and record.resources[i - 1] != r
                    subcontracts[r][record.resources[i - 1]] += 1
            for: r < resource_count
                if present[r]
                    case_counts[r] += 1
                for: s < resource_count
                    if seen_handover[r][s]
                        handover_cases[r][s] += 1
                    if r < s and present[r] and present[s]
                        together[r][s] += 1
        string[] lines := []
        for: r < resource_count
            items := [for a := (0:<int(activity_count))[] if work[r][a] > 0 then activities[a] + "={work[r][a]}"]
            lines = lines.append("RESOURCE {r + 1} {resources[r]} events {sum_values(work[r])} cases {case_counts[r]} work " + items.join(","))
        base := resource_count * resource_count
        upper := int(#events)
        int[] keys := []
        for: r < resource_count
            for: s < resource_count
                if r != s and handovers[r][s] > 0
                    keys = keys.append((upper - handovers[r][s]) * base + r * resource_count + s)
        for key := keys.sorted()[]
            pair := key % base
            r := pair / resource_count
            s := pair % resource_count
            lines = lines.append("HANDOVER {resources[r]} {resources[s]} count {handovers[r][s]} cases {handover_cases[r][s]}")
        cells := [for row := handovers[] then [for value := row[] then string(value)]]
        lines = lines.concat(dfg.table(cells, 5))
        keys = []
        for: r < resource_count
            for: s < resource_count
                if subcontracts[r][s] > 0
                    keys = keys.append((upper - subcontracts[r][s]) * base + r * resource_count + s)
        for key := keys.sorted()[]
            pair := key % base
            r := pair / resource_count
            s := pair % resource_count
            lines = lines.append("SUBCONTRACT {resources[r]} {resources[s]} count {subcontracts[r][s]}")
        keys = []
        for: r < resource_count
            for: r + 1 <= s < resource_count
                if together[r][s] > 0
                    keys = keys.append((case_count - together[r][s]) * base + r * resource_count + s)
        for key := keys.sorted()[]
            pair := key % base
            r := pair / resource_count
            s := pair % resource_count
            lines = lines.append("TOGETHER {resources[r]} {resources[s]} cases {together[r][s]}")
        all_handovers := sum_values([for row := handovers[] then sum_values(row)])
        self_handovers := sum_values([for r := (0:<int(resource_count))[] then handovers[r][r]])
        return lines.append("TOTAL handovers {all_handovers} self {self_handovers} other {all_handovers - self_handovers}")

void run_program()
    study := Study(eventlog.read_log(), extract_parameters(), conformance.read_model())
    report.write("log_summary.txt", study.log_summary())
    report.write("variants.txt", study.variant_lines())
    report.write("dfg.txt", study.dfg_lines())
    report.write("alpha_net.txt", study.alpha_lines())
    report.write("heuristic_net.txt", heuristic_lines(study.counts, study.triangles, study.activities, study.params))
    report.write("conformance.csv", study.conformance_rows())
    report.write("conformance.txt", study.conformance_lines())
    report.write("resources.txt", study.resource_lines())

run_program()

int gcd(int first, int second)
    a := first
    b := second
    while b != 0
        a, b = b, a % b
    return a

int[] ratio(int numerator, int denominator)
    magnitude := if numerator < 0 then -numerator else numerator
    divisor := gcd(magnitude, denominator)
    return [numerator / divisor, denominator / divisor]

int compare(int[] first, int[] second)
    a := first[0] * second[1]
    b := second[0] * first[1]
    return if a < b then -1 elif a > b then 1 else 0

int[] difference(int[] first, int[] second)
    return ratio(first[0] * second[1] - second[0] * first[1], first[1] * second[1])

string fraction(int[] value)
    reduced := ratio(value[0], value[1])
    negative := reduced[0] < 0
    magnitude := if negative then -reduced[0] else reduced[0]
    scaled := 10000 * magnitude / reduced[1]
    fraction_part := string(scaled % 10000)
    decimal_sign := if negative and scaled != 0 then "-" else ""
    return (if negative then "-" else "") + "{magnitude}/{reduced[1]}=" + decimal_sign + string(scaled / 10000) + "." + "0" * nat(4 - int(#fraction_part)) + fraction_part

string percentage(int numerator, int denominator)
    scaled := 10000 * numerator / denominator
    fraction_part := string(scaled % 100)
    return string(scaled / 100) + "." + (if #fraction_part == 1 then "0" else "") + fraction_part + "%"

string names(string[] values)
    return if #values == 0 then "-" else values.join(",")

void write(string name, string[] rows)
    writer1 := file.write("output/" + name)
    .writer1(rows.join(NL) + (if #rows == 0 then "" else NL))
